podcast.body: Released in 1988, this cover of Joy Division's iconic song is ironically considered by Michael Gira to be the "worst mistake of his entire career." Despite Gira's personal view, the single brought immense popularity to Swans, especially in the United States, and also significantly in Europe. It became, by far, their best-selling release until their later material in the late 90s. However, this popularity attracted a new audience that was largely disconnected from the aggressive, artistic, and performance-driven ethos Swans had always championed. The success of the single ultimately led the band to leave their independent labels and sign with a major label, a move that would subsequently lead to the critically panned and commercially disastrous album, *The Burning World*. "el propio Michael J. Laro definió como el peor error de toda su carrera."
